chunks: O Allah, make a wide place for him in Your shade, and reward him with multiplied goodness from Your bounty.

O Allah, elevate his structure above the structures of the builders, and honor his station with You, and perfect his light for him, and reward him for Your sending him with accepted testimony, pleasing speech, possessing just eloquence, and clear-cut oratory.

O Allah, unite us and him in the coolness of life, the stability of grace, the fulfillment of desires, the inclinations of pleasures, the ease of comfort, the peak of tranquility, and the gifts of honor.

key_terms.بِنَاءِ الْبَانِينَ: the construction of the builders (metaphor for status)

ai.seo_question: What are the key elements of the supplication for the Prophet in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This supplication, often recited in conjunction with the opening of Nahj al-Balagha, reflects the Shia tradition of seeking intercession and spiritual proximity to the Prophet through specific divine attributes. It emphasizes the Prophet's role as the ultimate guide ('man of just speech and eloquent sermon') and petitions for the believer's union with him in the eternal tranquility of Paradise, highlighting the concept of 'Barakah' (blessing) flowing from his station.

en.sayed-ali-raza: My Allāh prepare large place for him under Thy shade and award him multiplying good by Thy bounty.

My Allāh give height to his construction above all other constructions, heighten his position with Thee, grant perfection to his effulgence and perfect for him his light. In reward for his discharging Thy prophetship, grant him that his testimony be admitted and his speech be liked for his speech is just, and his judgements are clearcut.
My Allāh put us and him together in the pleasures of life, continuance of bounty, satisfaction of desires, enjoyment of pleasures, ease of living, peace of mind and gifts of honour.
